## Où j'en suis
Built the v2 dashboard grid on `react-grid-layout` behind the `dashboards_v2` flag: drag/resize with layout persisted server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (localStorage as offline fallback), widget sizing via a `useWidgetSize` ResizeObserver hook, `DashboardTile` renamed to `WidgetCard`, lint/typecheck clean and the Storybook build fixed. Draft PR #418 is open on `tom/dashboard-grid-v2` with Priya as UX reviewer, so the work is ready for review ahead of the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th.

- [en-cours] PR #418 is a draft, waiting on Priya's UX review on the iPad
- [prochaine-étape] enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only in the flags admin, before the 24th demo
- [essai-raté] container queries: silently ignored by iOS 15 Safari, so Zest's iPads never changed layout
- [décision] drop container queries entirely and use the ResizeObserver hook instead (source: t09)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: t15)
- [décision] open the PR as a draft for Priya's UX review (source: t17)
